from pydantic import BaseModel

    name: str

    "Given the following ratings and reviews for restaurants in Paris that serve French cuisine and are open on Sunday, select the restaurant with the best rating and reviews. Only provide the name.",
    BestRestaurantModel
).model_validate({"ratings_reviews": ratings_reviews})

best_name = best_restaurant.name

# Step 8: Get address and operating hours for the best restaurant
address = get_restaurants_address([best_name]).get(best_name, "")
operating_hours = opening_hours.get(best_name, "")
rating_review = ratings_reviews.get(best_name, "")

# Step 9: Print the result
print("Recommended French Restaurant in Paris (Open on Sunday):")
